wiki_article:
**EA-ARK-01-FRACTION v2.1: The Profane Ark** is a score and executable transform by Lee Sharks dated 16 March 2026, held in this record as a **metadata capture**.

The Space Ark (EA-ARK-01) is the archive's central transmissible object, and the **Fraction** transform produces its profane counterpart — Rex Fraction being the Dodecad voice under whose sign the archive's more combative and irreverent operations run. A score in this sense is executable: it specifies a transformation to be performed on the Ark rather than describing one.

The Ark's transform family is extensive — the glyphic vehicle at #556, the emoji strategy at #541, the Lunar Arm shadow at #540, the ASCII spatial transform at #1333 — and the Profane Ark belongs to it as the register-inversion. The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface passing the body-head gate at restoration time.
